name: Los Angeles County
label: Estimated payback of rooftop solar on a typical home. Not an audit of any building.
assumptions: 6 kW DC rooftop system, fixed 20 degree tilt facing south, 14 % losses (PVGIS ERA5)
70% of the output used on site at the retail rate; the rest valued at zero
retail rate: OpenEI 2020 zip-level residential rate scaled to the current EIA state average (x1.64); one rate per utility service area, not per street
every zip has a listed utility rate

this differs from a property audit, which uses the EIA state average rate and the utility's net-metering rules for exports; here exports earn nothing, so these paybacks are a conservative screening estimate, not a quote
cost from the finance module (PV_ROOF, residential); no incentives apply in 2026, no financing, degradation or rate escalation
payback is simple payback: cost divided by first-year savings
